payload.title: Discount rounding

candidate.code:
def solve(args):
    total = sum(item['unit_minor'] * item['quantity'] for item in args['items'])
    bps = args['discount_bps']
    scaled = total * (10000 - bps)
    return (scaled + 5000) // 10000
candidate.explanation: The original used float arithmetic (1 - bps/10000) and int() truncation, which both loses precision and truncates instead of rounding half up. Repaired with exact integer math: scaled = total * (10000 - bps), then round half up via (scaled + 5000) // 10000.
